Give Star Trek Online a look. It's free to play, though the higher tier ships are paid. That said, even paid items, you can grind out with in-game currency. All of the content is available, but the higher end stuff might be tricky with the free ships. Most of the cash shop items are cosmetic or minor perks, with the only real biggies being ships. I was dismayed at first by there being "only three" classes, but: There's three base classes, which can pilot several different types of ships, which all have several different bridge officer layouts, and bridge officers have several different abilities you can give them. For ground combat, you have an away team that you also can customize, as well as different "kits" you equip on your captain, that also have completely unique abilities.

So "three classes" becomes an absolute wealth of different options. No two characters of mine are the same. I've got a science captain who focuses on drains and control, and one who focuses on buffs, healing, and durability. My biggest complaint with the game is that post 50, the episode structure of the game gets a little thrown off track.
